title: joint_trajectory_controller for arms
keywords: joint_trajectory_controller trajectory arm joints follow_joint_trajectory goal rejected aborted tolerance constraints time_from_start partial
text: joint_trajectory_controller follows trajectories from <controller>/follow_joint_trajectory (action) or <controller>/joint_trajectory (topic). Unless allow_partial_joints_goal is true, a goal must list every joint of the controller, with names that match its joints. Tolerances under constraints (goal_time, stopped_velocity_tolerance, and per-joint trajectory and goal tolerances) abort a goal when violated, and the controller then holds the current position. Points need increasing time_from_start. A goal that is rejected or aborted right away usually has missing joints, wrong names or tolerances that are too tight.
